propositions: Comment blocks across 439 src/rebar files must be triaged against taxonomy: history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, logic to code, contracts to schema, with only proximate just-in-time context retained inline.

Six subsystem shards (reconciler, plan_review+workflow, store/reducer, llm core, commands/CLI, root/services) must each produce a do_not_move list, append it to .joe-janitor/tools.md before landing, and measure actual comment lines recovered by diff.

Verified-stale comments documenting live invariants must be corrected in place; load-bearing comments (API facts, anti-refactor warnings, pragma directives, introspection-read docstrings) must be retained verbatim and recorded as DO_NOT_MOVE.
All proposed ADRs (0062-0069) must exist and be committed before any inline block citing them is collapsed to a one-line citation.

Six shards must land separately in dependency order (9ce8→4fc1→4b94→ad16→da4c→ab77) with all tests, lint, and typecheck passing unchanged; net line recovery is an output of correct disposition, not a fixed target.
